page.title: Calorie — A private food journal for weight loss
page.description: A private, local-first iPhone and iPad journal for food, four core nutrients, water, weight, routines, and transparent timing guidance.

hero.title: A private food journal for weight loss *with math you can inspect.*
hero.lede: Log meals, four nutrients, water, weight, and routines in seconds. See transparent fasting, exercise, and sleep estimates from your timestamps and targets.
hero.note: Internal TestFlight only. No public invite or App Store listing.

screen.alt: Calorie Today on iPhone: energy left for the day, protein, carbs, fat and fibre, and a food journal with breakfast and a snack

sections.title: Log a familiar meal *in seconds.*
sections.lede: Reuse a saved food, add a one-off, choose an amount, and keep the real eating time. The journal is designed for one-handed logging immediately after a meal.

screen.alt: Calorie quick log sheet for adding a saved or one-off food with an amount and eating time

sections.title: Every estimate *shows its inputs.*
sections.lede: Calorie uses food timestamps, four nutrients, water, routines, weight, and your own targets to estimate fasting, exercise, and sleep windows. The rules stay visible, and the result is never medical advice.

sections.title: Compare seven *and thirty days.*
sections.lede: Review intake, eating rhythm, timing, and weight with the sample size and missing days visible. Progress is context, not a streak or a moral score.

screen.alt: Calorie Progress comparing intake, eating rhythm, timing and weight over seven and thirty days

sections.title: The journal *stays yours.*
sections.lede: The default journal lives on the device and needs no account. Optional Sign in with Apple can keep a private, user-scoped copy in Cloudflare D1.

aside.title: Calorie may fit if
aside.body: you are pursuing weight loss and want a private iPhone or iPad journal with fast logging and timing you can audit.

aside.title: It is not
aside.body: medical care, a barcode scanner, or a social feed. It will not prescribe a deficit.

items.a: No. The native journal works on this device without one. Sign in with Apple is optional private sync.
No. Timing suggestions are estimates from the numbers you enter. They are not diagnosis or treatment.

items.q: Is the iPhone app on the App Store?
items.a: Not yet. This site will not show Apple’s badge until a live apps.apple.com listing exists.
There is no paid plan or checkout. Access is currently limited to invited internal TestFlight testers, and no permanent free or paid model has been announced.
